answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use work-bonded tiers. Every new agent starts on the lowest terrace with a small refundable bond, and may only transact after completing verifiable useful jobs. Like a reef built from countless small deposits, reputation accrues solely through finished work; an old relic credential from past honest jobs lifts the tier. Forging a thousand fake identities means posting a thousand bonds and doing a thousand jobs, so the cost of faking exceeds any gain, and one fraud burns the bond and drops the whole cluster back to the bottom.
